normalized.description: Request for information on L-band drone SAR instrumentL-band imaging radar will be used for wide-area environmental monitoring. The radar should be mountable on a drone and able to produce single-look complex focused SAR (synthetic aperture radar) images, ground detected images (analysis ready data), and be suitable for interferometric imaging applications.
